title.title: Gersten's conjecture for one-relator groups
title.subtitle: Claim: a one-relator group with no Baumslag–Solitar subgroup is hyperbolic

beats.text: Baumslag–Solitar groups are the standard obstruction to hyperbolicity
Gersten (1992): for one-relator groups they are the only one
Claimed, with a companion: such groups are also virtually compact special

achievement.label: Gersten's conjecture (1992)
statement: G = \langle X \mid r \rangle,\ \mathrm{BS}(m,n) \not\le G \;\Rightarrow\; G \text{ hyperbolic}
achievement.context: Before: the torsion case (Newman 1968) and negative immersions (Louder–Wilton, Linton)
achievement.note: The two papers, 53 and 145 pages, each use the other

verify.ourCheck: We read the main theorem and caveats; nothing was checked independently

sources.quote: (a) Every finitely generated one-relator group with no Baumslag-Solitar subgroup BS(m,n) (m,n nonzero) is word-hyperbolic (Gersten's conjecture). (b) Every hyperbolic one-relator group is virtually compact special
